Interface LetterProgression

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractLetterProgression, DifficultyProgression, SequentialProgression
public interface LetterProgression
Defines the sequence of ASL letters presented during a game session.

Each session injects its own progression strategy:

  • SequentialProgression — A → Z order for practice mode
  • DifficultyProgression — easiest → hardest tier for battle mode

The progression acts as a stateful cursor. Call advance() after a letter is successfully cleared to move to the next one.
